name: Employer-Sponsored Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: The Department of Immigration, under the Immigration Act [Chapter 4:02], issues work permits requiring a job offer letter from a Zimbabwean company, proof of qualifications and work experience (documented in English), and a valid radiological certificate confirming freedom from active pulmonary tuberculosis. Different classes of work permit exist for different circumstances, though the specific class distinctions were not detailed in the source reviewed. Applications can also be submitted via the e-Permits online platform (epermits.zimimmigration.gov.zw).
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Zimbabwean employer and submit the application with qualification proof and a TB clearance certificate.

evidence_required.document: Job offer letter from a Zimbabwean company
Proof of qualifications and work experience (in English)

sources.title: Cliffe Dekker Hofmeyr (Africa-corporate law firm guide) -- Department of Immigration's work permit process under the Immigration Act [Chapter 4:02], job-offer requirement, and documentary requirements
